window.if_did_not_close_use: If it did not close, use “Force”.
backends.only_xwayland_windows_visible_l: — only XWayland windows are visible, look for the rest in “Processes”
window.kwin_did_not_respond_could: KWin did not respond — could not bring the window to the front.
window.pid_unknown_only_polite_window: PID unknown — only polite window closing is available.
window.x11_click_window_wayland_3: X11: click a window. Wayland: in 3 seconds I will take the active window.
window.all_your_processes_have_launch: All your processes that have a launch command.
window.select_window_left_close_politely: Select a window on the left. “Close” — politely, “Force” — kill the process immediately.
window.program_s_own_window_was: The program’s own window was selected — switch to another and try again.
window.bring_window_front_so_you: Bring the window to the front — so you can see which program it is
window.action_applies_window_s_process: The action applies to the window’s process and all its child processes
window.forced_closing_closing_tree: For forced closing and closing a tree
window.could_not_close_window_directly: Could not close the window directly — sent SIGTERM to process “{}”.
window.clicking_list_item_brings_window: Clicking a list item brings its window to the front
window.click_window_you_need_program: Click the window you need — the program will take whatever becomes active.
window.could_not_bring_window_front: Could not bring the window to the front.
window.window_not_identified_try_again: Window not identified. Try again or find it in the list.
window.window_hides_while_picking_comes: The window hides while picking and comes back afterwards
window.program_s_window_not_visible: This program’s window is not visible to the window manager, so it cannot be shown. On KDE Wayland the kdotool utility helps.
window.window_was_asked_close_if: The window “{}” was asked to close. If it asks “save?” — answer in it.
window.picking_window_by_click_not: Picking a window by click is not possible: no hyprctl, swaymsg, wmctrl or xprop. Look for the program in “Applications”.
window.programs_with_graphics_like_syste: Programs with graphics (like in the system monitor); windows are added if visible.
window.programs_with_windows_like_system: Programs with windows, like in the system monitor
window.process_not_found_may_have: Process not found — it may have already exited.
window.first_select_window_process_list: First select a window or process in the list.
backends.window_list_unavailable_hyprctl: Window list is unavailable (hyprctl, swaymsg, wmctrl or xprop needed) — use “Processes”
window.only_windows_window_manager_sees: Only windows the window manager sees
window.has_no_open_window_may: “{}” has no open window (it may be minimized to the tray or be a background process).
window.program_itself_system_process_not: This is the program itself or a system process — not touching it.
